summary: Deep Combat Sinister Strike with a slow axe in the main hand and a fast axe in the off hand: Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Hack and Slash and Cold Blood. The rogue's default and best build.
keyTalents: Hack and Slash 5/5 (axe and sword extra attacks)
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Adrenaline Rush under 39 energy while Slice and Dice is up
Blade Flurry on cooldown while Slice and Dice is up
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 5 combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6 s left); spend leftover points in the last 3 s
Sinister Strike right after a main-hand swing (0.5 s), or at 79+ energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets: 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and an on-use 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min (at the pull, then on cooldown).
Swords keep 5-point Eviscerates. 4 points lose 6 to 8 DPS.
Murder (+4% damage vs Humanoids and Giants) does nothing on the generic boss. Its 2 points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers). The vs Humanoid build keeps Murder 2/2.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV). They would add 13 to 18.
Grimstitch 4-piece and 5-piece bonuses aren't active on the synthetic gear (about +8 and +6 for Combat Daggers).
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir left out for consistency (+8 through Dragonbreath Chili).
Best Alliance race is Human. Since client 70425 the races are within about 3 DPS of each other.
notes: Class default preset (default gear, talents, rotation, race and consumes); default for the Combat raid-sim preset.
